next:or:1008.hint: 人間関係の良さを表す慣用句
next:or:1008.question: He [[is in good terms with]] his neighbors.
next:or:1008.fullSentence: He is on good terms with his neighbors.
next:or:1008.explanation: be on good terms with A『Aと良好な間柄だ』。termsは常に複数形。
next:or:1008.relatedInfo: be on bad terms with Aで『不仲だ』となる。

next:or:1009.hint: 良い知らせを聞いて彼女は上機嫌だった
next:or:1009.fullSentence: She was in high spirits after hearing the good news.
next:or:1009.explanation: be in high(good/great) spirits『機嫌がよい』。spiritsは常に複数形。
next:or:1009.relatedInfo: be in low spiritsで『元気がない』の意味。

next:or:1010.hint: 輪郭のない日陰を表す語
next:or:1010.question: They rested in the [[shadow]] of the tree.
next:or:1010.fullSentence: They rested in the shade of the tree.
next:or:1010.relatedInfo: shadowは人や物の形をした影を指す。

next:or:1011.hint: 3時に歯医者の予約(面会の約束)がある
next:or:1011.fullSentence: I have a dentist's appointment at three o'clock.
next:or:1011.explanation: appointment『面会の約束』⇔reservation『座席・部屋などの予約』。
next:or:1011.relatedInfo: レストランやホテルの予約にはreservationを使う。

next:or:1012.hint: 見知らぬ・不案内なことを表す名詞
next:or:1012.question: I am [[a stranger of this city]].
next:or:1012.fullSentence: I am a stranger to this city.
next:or:1012.explanation: stranger『不案内な人、見知らぬ人』。be a stranger to A『Aに不案内だ』。
next:or:1012.relatedInfo: 知らない人という意味だけでなく『不慣れな人』の意味も持つ。

next:or:1013.hint: 彼はたいした歌手ではない
next:or:1013.fullSentence: He is not much of a singer.
next:or:1013.explanation: not much of a ~『たいした〜ではない』。
next:or:1013.relatedInfo: 控えめな評価を表す慣用表現。

next:or:1014.hint: 全く知らないことを表す慣用句
next:or:1014.question: I [[have any idea]] about it.
next:or:1014.fullSentence: I have no idea about it.
next:or:1014.explanation: have no idea = don't have any idea『まったくわからない』。
next:or:1014.relatedInfo: I have no idea. だけでも使える。

next:or:1015.hint: 到着したらあなたに一筆書くと約束する
next:or:1015.fullSentence: I promise to drop you a line when I arrive.
next:or:1015.explanation: drop A a line『Aに一筆書く』。
next:or:1015.relatedInfo: カジュアルな短い手紙・メッセージを送ることを表す。

next:or:1016.hint: 職業を尋ねるやや口語的な表現
next:or:1016.question: [[What line do you in]]?
next:or:1016.explanation: What line are you in?『お仕事は何ですか』。lineは『職業、業種』の意味。
next:or:1016.relatedInfo: What is your job?よりやや口語的。

next:wr:1.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:1.hint: 母が死んでから10年になる
next:wr:1.answer: It has been ten years since my mother died.
next:wr:1.fullSentence: It has been ten years since my mother died.
next:wr:1.explanation: It is/has been+期間+since S 過去形『〜してから…になる』。
next:wr:1.relatedInfo: = My mother has been dead for ten years. = Ten years have passed since my mother died.

next:wr:3.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:3.hint: 来年までに英単語を千語覚えたことになるだろう
next:wr:3.answer: By next year, I will have learned a thousand English words.
next:wr:3.fullSentence: By next year, I will have learned a thousand English words.
next:wr:3.explanation: 未来のある時点までの完了・経験は未来完了形(will have pp)で表す。
next:wr:3.relatedInfo: by the time, by next monthなどと相性が良い。

next:wr:5.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:5.hint: 何て美しい家だ!誰にちなんで名付けられたのだろう(受身の完了)
next:wr:5.answer: What a beautiful house! Who was it named for?
next:wr:5.fullSentence: What a beautiful house! Who was it named for?
next:wr:5.explanation: Her parents named the baby Harper.(SVOC)→ The baby was named Harper by her parents.のように、受動態でもCがそのまま残る。
next:wr:5.relatedInfo: 疑問文の語順に注意(was it)。

next:wr:7.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:7.hint: 彼は若い頃偉大な学者だったと言われている
next:wr:7.answer: He is said to have been a great scholar in his day.
next:wr:7.fullSentence: He is said to have been a great scholar in his day.
next:wr:7.explanation: 言われている内容が文の述語動詞より前の時であるためto have ppの形になる。
next:wr:7.relatedInfo: It is said that he was a great scholar in his day. と書き換え可能。

next:wr:9.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:9.hint: 新宿駅でトムと会う予定だ
next:wr:9.answer: I'm going to meet Tom at Shinjuku station.
next:wr:9.fullSentence: I'm going to meet Tom at Shinjuku station.
next:wr:9.explanation: be going to doは既に決まっている予定を表す。
next:wr:9.relatedInfo: 待ち合わせ場所→時、の語順で情報を加えることが多い。

next:wr:11.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:11.hint: 私が気づく前に彼は駅に着いていた(過去完了)
next:wr:11.answer: He had arrived at the station before I had noticed it.
next:wr:11.fullSentence: He had arrived at the station before I had noticed it.
next:wr:11.explanation: 過去のある時点よりさらに前の出来事は過去完了(had+Vpp)で表す。
next:wr:11.relatedInfo: last week, ago, when と組み合わさることが多い。

next:wr:14.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:14.hint: この映画を見ると泣かずにはいられない
next:wr:14.answer: I can't help crying when I watch this movie.
next:wr:14.fullSentence: I can't help crying when I watch this movie.
next:wr:14.explanation: can't help doing『〜せずにはいられない』。
next:wr:14.relatedInfo: cannot help but do とほぼ同義。

next:wr:16.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:16.hint: 彼はこの写真を見ると必ず泣いてしまう(二重否定で強い肯定)
next:wr:16.answer: He never sees this photo without crying.
next:wr:16.fullSentence: He never sees this photo without crying.
next:wr:16.explanation: never...without ~ing『〜すると必ず…する』。全否定の慣用表現。

next:wr:18.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:18.hint: 彼が今家にいるはずがない
next:wr:18.answer: He cannot be at home now.
next:wr:18.fullSentence: He cannot be at home now.
next:wr:18.explanation: cannotは否定文で強い推量「〜のはずがない」を表す(⟺must「〜に違いない」)。
next:wr:18.relatedInfo: must not doとは意味が異なる点に注意。

next:wr:20.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:20.hint: 彼女は新しい言語を学ぶことに興味がある
next:wr:20.answer: She is interested in learning new languages.
next:wr:20.fullSentence: She is interested in learning new languages.
next:wr:20.explanation: be interested in A『Aに興味がある』。感情を表す受身+前置詞のグループの一つ。
next:wr:20.relatedInfo: be surprised at/be excited aboutも同グループ。

next:wr:22.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:22.hint: 帰り道でにわか雨に遭った
next:wr:22.answer: We were caught in a sudden shower on our way home.
next:wr:22.fullSentence: We were caught in a sudden shower on our way home.
next:wr:22.explanation: be caught in A『A(雨など)に巻き込まれる、遭う』。
next:wr:22.relatedInfo: be caught in the rain「にわか雨に遭う」のように使う。

next:wr:24.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:24.hint: あなたは明日までにこの報告書を仕上げなければならない
next:wr:24.answer: You must finish this report by tomorrow.
next:wr:24.fullSentence: You must finish this report by tomorrow.
next:wr:24.explanation: must do『〜しなければならない(義務)』。否定形の対比に注意: must not do「してはいけない(禁止)」⟺ don't have to do「する必要がない(不要)」。
next:wr:24.relatedInfo: mustの否定的な推量表現はcannot「〜のはずがない」を使う(must notではない)。

next:wr:26.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:26.hint: この短いフォームに記入さえすればよい
next:wr:26.answer: You have only to fill out this short form.
next:wr:26.fullSentence: You have only to fill out this short form.
next:wr:26.explanation: have only to do『〜さえすればよい』。
next:wr:26.relatedInfo: ＝ All you have to do is (to) fill out this short form。

next:wr:28.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:28.hint: お聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか(丁寧な推量疑問)
next:wr:28.answer: Might I ask you a question?
next:wr:28.fullSentence: Might I ask you a question?
next:wr:28.explanation: mayの過去形mightを疑問文に使うと控えめ・丁寧なニュアンスになる。
next:wr:28.relatedInfo: May I ~?よりさらに丁寧な言い方。

next:wr:30.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:30.hint: 彼が文句を言うのももっともだ
next:wr:30.explanation: may well do『〜するのももっともだ』＝ It is only natural that S should do。
next:wr:30.relatedInfo: may as well doとは意味が異なる点に注意。

next:wr:32.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:32.hint: 彼にお金を貸すくらいなら、捨てる方がましだ
next:wr:32.answer: You might as well throw your money away as lend it to him.
next:wr:32.fullSentence: You might as well throw your money away as lend it to him.
next:wr:32.explanation: might as well do as ~『〜するくらいなら…する方がましだ』。やや皮肉を込めた比較表現。
next:wr:32.relatedInfo: as以下には比較対象となる行為が入る。
